business_problem: SERTECPET needed to replace location-bound ERP processes with a cloud platform that could consolidate finance and production data across remote plants while supporting secure, scalable operations.
solution_summary: SERTECPET extended an ERP modernization program it had been running with Microsoft and AlfaPeople into a cloud operating model for production plants in Ecuador, Colombia, and Peru. Key components include Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management runs production and supply-chain processes across plants and scales users as production demand changes; Dynamics 365 Finance consolidates financial information from distributed operations into the same cloud business system; Power BI turns Dynamics 365 data into dashboards that management uses to refine operations; Azure hosts the SaaS deployment so remote plants can use the system securely from anywhere. SERTECPET gained online visibility into plant operations, consolidated information across sites, and used Power BI-modeled dashboards to improve management while keeping the platform usable in remote production locations.
